backend: unmodified Sionna RT 2.0.1 PathSolver and FieldCalculator

detector.frequency_guard: full float64-le frequency array SHA plus finite/shape/monotonic checks
detector.historical_fixture_result: 3/5000 is preserved; not production calibration or statistical acceptance evidence
detector.location: canonical 30 percent leading-edge on strongest branch after presence pass; biased relative to path tau
detector.null_test_arm: single arm per independent trial; paired arms are not extra independent trials

statistical_validation.stop_rule: exactly 20000 trials; no optional stopping, seed changes, or posthoc extra trials; failure remains failure
statistical_validation.upper_bound: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson beta.ppf(0.95, false_alarms+1, trials-false_alarms)

detector.theoretical_bound: union bound with marginal circular Gaussian taps; no independent CIR-tap assumption

ideal_material_mapping.EPS4_LOSSLESS: native RadioMaterial epsilon_r=4 with manifest thickness

model: one RF reference sheet per physical slab; no duplicate inner/back boundary

noise.complex_gaussian: E|n|^2=noise_var_H_bin; each real and imaginary component variance is half
noise.covariance_H: independent bins, RX modes and sequential TX-mode estimates within an arm; paired identical noise samples across CP/LP arms for each common link/replicate
noise.historical_static9_noise: preserve clean analytic baseline; noisy observation is a separately named downstream overlay
noise.injection_point: complex absolute H after correct incident-referenced antenna normalization and path sum, before Hann and IFFT; also for zero-path H
noise.observation_model: Sequential narrowband tone transfer estimates, 257 frequencies; 64 independent complex estimates averaged per tone and TX mode
noise.rng: existing canonical matlab_mt19937 implementation; verify exact producer pairing in P4/P5
noise.seed_rule: SHA256 of common scene/link/frame/replicate plus seed_base, first 32 bits little-endian; omit arm name
noise.selection_basis: Equal incident power and per-tone integration budget across arms; 290 K thermal reference, 6 dB design NF, 1.95 MHz per-tone ENBW selected explicitly as synthetic operating point, not inferred from df
